test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the pair of letter-clusters which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two sets of pair of letter-clusters given below. Both pairs of letter-clusters follow the same pattern.

DAC : NKM

PNM : ZXW
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

Logic:- (10) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

**Given:**

 
• DAC : NKM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be932cb1e93d7906c2b30960110e4891240b85fdf0d490f0106002a4bcc6f8cc.png] 

 
• **PNM : ZXW**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/422fd4d5d43ba925a167e0c5db1437bc32bea71d5dae04c4d32a496fa612fc92.png] 

​So,

 
• Option - (1): HIJ : EFG

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccfd69d90118287931a7cdbf53e9c712cf5d63d7332b734224659ef1e717c88a.png] 

 
• **Option - (2): GJM : QTW​​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c5f507f42cedf7b77c99c3fe27b82dea530cdf4a6c4830912669925897e9e94.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : POQ : STU

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4e298b32a6dd0d71eaccb62d72514329971e054a1414c59d0146b4057fea517.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : KHG : ADE

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9712451e0b410496207172bf61bce2c5d6013fe45a719ca9b28041fdd986ddd1.png] 

Thus, out of all options only '**GJM : QTW**' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option - (2)**".
